verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a public REST API for managing data and features, and publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec rendered as a Redoc reference, with documented resource versioning and a dated API changelog. The 404 probes only checked openapi.json/swagger paths, not the published openapi.yaml, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk. The API documentation helps you build your own solutions.

sevdesk publishes its full OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (671 KB YAML, base https://my.sevdesk.de/api/v1) as a downloadable file that is also the source its Redoc reference at api.sevdesk.de renders directly.
We use resource versioning to handle breaking changes for our endpoints, these are rarely used and will be communicated before we remove older versions
